damodaran_egypt.notes: Extracted from sheets 'ERPs by country' (Egypt row) and '10-year CDS Spreads' (Egypt row) of the original workbook, saved alongside as ctryprem_snapshot.xlsx. urea_fob_egypt.notes: TradingView continuous front-month quote for CME/CBOT Urea (Granular) FOB Egypt futures, contract size 100 MT. CME's own quotes page is JS-rendered and returned no data through the proxy; Investing.com's page served stale historical data (730.00 for a May-26 contract dated 18-Mar-2026, self-flagged as historical; 52-week range 380.00-730.00 — 730 is the 52wk high, not the current price). Forward-curve points were NOT obtainable from any accessible source; only the front month is recorded. Cross-check against a primary quote (CME settlement file or Argus/Profercy assessment) before using as a driver anchor.

egypt_cpi.notes: Headline urban CPI y/y per TradingEconomics (sourced from CAPMAS/CBE). Third consecutive month of easing, lowest since Feb-2026. The July-2026 print may land ~10-Aug; re-check before publication.

egch_shares.notes: PRIMARY SOURCE FAILED: egx.com.eg (company profile page and its listing PDFs) is behind an F5/TSPD JS bot-challenge that blocked WebFetch (503), curl (challenge HTML), and headless Chromium via the proxy (connection reset) — the exchange-stated figure was NOT obtained. Fallback: stockanalysis.com and TradingView agree on price 13.98 EGP and market cap 27.77bn EGP as of 6-Aug-2026, implying ~1.986bn shares; stockanalysis states 1.99bn shares outstanding. TradingView's headline '197.95M shares' is inconsistent with its own market cap (off by 10x; likely free float). A stale EGX listing PDF surfaced in search states 394,042,710 shares at par EGP 5 — almost certainly pre-capital-increase; do not use. SIGCM: confirm the exact share count and paid-in capital from the company's own FS/EGX disclosure before the WACC's market-value equity weight is finalized.

egypt_corporate_spread_context.notes: SKIPPED — no reliable recent EGP corporate/securitization pricing vs sovereign found through accessible sources (searches surfaced only sovereign paper). Sovereign context captured instead: a new EGP 120.9bn treasury bond maturing 21-May-2029 listed with a 23.098% fixed annual coupon (semi-annual pay), consistent with the ~23% 10Y and ~25.5% 1Y secondary yields above. Kd for EGCH must still be built as sovereign + a corporate credit spread from a sourced comp or the company's own facilities, per the WACC rule that a same-currency corporate cannot borrow below its sovereign.
